title: durabaculum spathulatum
intro: Durabaculum spathulatum, commonly known as the Himalayan vine, is a woody climbing vine native to the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Durabaculum spathulatum include its ability to act as a vasodilator, which can help to lower blood pressure and improve blood circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
